subject.title: fix (Computer Use) Stabilize Codex Computer Use readiness

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's fail-closed live Computer Use readiness probe plus the eight new Computer Use config/cache/health/lease controls as the Codex plugin compatibility direction?
rationale: The remaining concern is maintainer intent, not a narrow code defect: the patch changes startup behavior, plugin cache handling, sandbox exception policy, and user-visible defaults for existing Codex Computer Use users.

options.title: Accept After Exact-Head Refresh
options.body: Land the current direction after required CI/exact-head proof is current, with the narrowed explicit-marketplace and configured-server protections preserved.

options.title: Split Broad Surfaces
options.body: Land only the cache/readiness repair and split periodic health, auto-repair, fallback, and lease APIs into a maintainer-sponsored follow-up.

options.title: Pause Direction
options.body: Pause or close this branch if fail-closed readiness and new operator knobs are not the desired core Codex plugin behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept After Exact-Head Refresh
recommendation.body: Land the current direction after required CI/exact-head proof is current, with the narrowed explicit-marketplace and configured-server protections preserved.
